name: Hermes CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Typecheck, test, and build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Enable Corepack
        run: corepack enable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Typecheck
        run: pnpm typecheck

      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Build all packages
        run: pnpm build
